51 weeks + 7 days = 51*7 + 7 = 357 + 7 = 364 days.  
364 days = 52 weeks exactly.  
Adding 364 days to 1204-09-13:  
1204 is a leap year (divisible by 4), so from 09-13, adding 364 days = 52 weeks later = same weekday, date moves back 1 day because 52 weeks = 364 days, not 365.  
So 1204-09-13 + 364 days = 1205-09-12.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1205-09-12
